# castai_organization_groups (Data Source)

Lists groups in a Cast AI organization, e.g. SCIM-synced groups created by the IdP that never enter Terraform state. To look up a single group by its exact name, use the castai_organization_group data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List groups filtered by how they are managed. SCIM-synced groups come from
# the identity provider and only exist on the CAST AI side, so managed_by =
# ["idp-sync"] surfaces exactly those. An empty result is an empty list.
data "castai_organization_groups" "idp" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  managed_by      = ["idp-sync"]
}

locals {
  idp_groups_by_name = { for g in data.castai_organization_groups.idp.groups : g.name => g }
}

output "platform_group_id" {
  value = local.idp_groups_by_name["platform-engineers"].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Cast AI organization ID.

### Optional

- `managed_by` (List of String) Server-side filter by how the groups are managed. One or more of: console, terraform, idp-sync, sso-default. Unset returns all groups.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (List of Object) List of groups matching the filters. Empty when nothing matches; this is not an error. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
